name: plonetheme-imioapps
description: SCSS sources for the iMio applications theme

scripts.build: npm run build:base && npm run build:skins
scripts.build:base: sass --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps --no-source-map --style=compressed scss/theme.scss styles/theme.min.css && sass --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps --no-source-map scss/theme.scss styles/theme.css
scripts.build:skins: sass --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps --no-source-map --style=compressed scss/skins/skin-iadelib.scss styles/skin-iadelib.min.css && sass --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps --no-source-map --style=compressed scss/skins/skin-ged.scss styles/skin-ged.min.css
